**Observations from test image:**
- Microscopic/hand-lens view of stem tissue
- Tan/bleached fibrous stem surface
- Numerous tiny dark specks (microsclerotia) densely scattered throughout the tissue
- Classic "charcoal dust" appearance on internal stem tissue

**Analysis:** The dense scattering of tiny black microsclerotia on bleached stem tissue is the hallmark diagnostic feature of Charcoal Rot (*Macrophomina phaseolina*). The reference images confirm the bleached stem appearance. The microscopic dark specks visible in the test image match the microsclerotia that give this disease its "charcoal" name.
